name: Compiler validation

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: GCC
            compiler: gcc-13
            sanitizer: none
          - name: GCC Release
            compiler: gcc-13
            sanitizer: none
            build_type: Release
          - name: Clang
            compiler: clang-23
            sanitizer: none
          - name: ASan
            compiler: clang-23
            sanitizer: address
          - name: UBSan
            compiler: clang-23
            sanitizer: undefined
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

# LLVM-independent Production source/checker and existing C17/native reference
# regression only. PARTIAL evidence; never replaces the LLVM 23.1.2 full matrix.
name: Compiler frontend/C17 reference (NO LLVM; PARTIAL)

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  frontend-c17-partial:
    name: Production CHECK + C17/native reference (NO LLVM; PARTIAL)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out source without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify available Ubuntu runner tools (no LLVM install)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for tool in gcc make cmake python3 ctest; do
            command -v "$tool"
          done
          gcc --version | head -n 1
          cmake --version | head -n 1
          python3 --version
          ctest --version | head -n 1

      - name: Configure and build the actual Production frontend with GCC (no LLVM)
        shell: bash
        run: |

name: R-FAST self-service pre-PR preparation (NOT R validation)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'r-fast/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: r-fast-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  preflight:
    name: R-FAST pinned format + GCC build + CTest registration only
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable push SHA without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 3
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify opt-in R-FAST push and exact immutable checkout
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "push"
          case "$GITHUB_REF" in
            refs/heads/r-fast/*) ;;
            *) echo "STOP: not an opt-in R-FAST ref"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          test "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = "branch"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
